{{Top|leg}}
The '''City Boss''' was the most powerful government leader of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Belgar]] the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]]. However, as the planet was effectively anarchical, the City Boss's orders were treated as no more than suggestions. During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the City Boss used Belgar's old [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison as a residence and administration building.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
